english.standardoffencewording:

(B)_[caused a child aged 16 years, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..),]_
(C)_[procured a person under the age of 16 years, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_
(D)_[procured a child aged 16 years, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..),]_
(E)_[,being the parent or guardian of a person under the age of 16 years, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), allowed him]_
(F)_[,being the parent or guardian of a person under the age of 16 years, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), allowed her]_
(G)_[,being the parent or guardian of a child aged 16 years, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..), allowed him]_
(H)_[,being the parent or guardian of a child aged 16 years, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..), allowed her]_

(I)_[his]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 23 of the Children and Young Persons Act 1933.
